summary: Froze the current registry, Python/browser retrieval rules, comparator and evaluator before authoring a second sealed wave of 28 confirmation questions. Added exact evidence anchors and a studio ledger with separate source recall, wrong-source and empty misses, unsupported false support and empty unsupported retrieval. BM25 finds 19/20 expected sources at rank 1 versus 16/20 for overlap; both find 20/20 at rank 3 and return evidence for 4/8 unsupported questions. Negative outcomes and prior studies are preserved.
